name: Days of Memories ~Boku to Kanojo no Atsui Natsu~
original_name: Days of Memories 〜僕と彼女の熱い夏〜
source:
Beautiful female warriors and other charming girls from SNK games make their appearances in this innovative dating simulation game.

The first game depicts the adventures of the male lead (player character) and the the female cast. During the last summer of high school, the player has a premonition that something will happen between himself and the girls he came to know and became friends with.

[from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9g-49-en-70-2q33.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
